role: Zone 2, the pine forest. Settled as PINE FOREST WITH CAMP (Q6, 2026-10-02) and re-scoped 2026-10-07: the forest is a GENERATED map (Lead: Path-of-Exile-style, vague preset shape + seeded variables, and when asked for a static T0 placement the Lead chose 'straight to generation'). The player commits to one forest by crossing ONE of FIELD's two identical forest edges; that crossing instantiates this zone. The camp, the spirit wound and the return shrine are AUTHORED slots inserted into the generated forest - the camp is structurally incapable of landing in the field.
origin_note: NO FIXED WORLD ORIGIN (Lead 2026-10-07, 'straight to generation'). The instance origin is the midpoint of whichever FIELD forest edge was crossed. Zone-local frame: (0,0,0) = entry band centre on the edge line, +y = deeper into the forest (away from the field), x = lateral along the edge, z = ground at the FIELD datum (z = -95 world). Entering EDGE_FOREST_A (south) vs EDGE_FOREST_B (west) only rotates this frame; every slot below is identical, which is what keeps the two forests indistinguishable from inside the field.

generation.model: Path-of-Exile-style: a preset skeleton (vague shape, edge contracts, content budget, authored slots) plus seeded variables (shape jitter, scatter placement). See docs/39_ZONE_GENERATION_RESEARCH.md.
generation.trigger: Lead 2026-10-07: the field generates first and places the assets on each decided edge. The player reaching the bounds of a pine_forest edge's assets instantiates this zone and then pins the camp. The meadow centre does not.
generation.seed: hash(FIELD instance seed, edge id) - deterministic: the same forest is the same map on revisit, and a save stores seed + deltas (healed wisps, freed companion, tamed beasts) rather than geometry
generation.dormancy: the UNCHOSEN forest edge keeps its neighbor dormant - 'a road they did not take' (FIELD.camp_placement) costs nothing under this model: no instance exists until crossed

shape.kind: blob with a depth band, treeline on the entry side
shape.width_note: matches the 420 m field edge span so the forest reads as a band beyond the meadow, not a corridor
shape.jitter: +/-15% on extent, edge band drift +/-25 m - silhouette-level variation only; the entry-side treeline read NEVER varies (hard constraint below)
shape.numbers_status: agent-proposed, flagged for the Lead (docs/39 section 7 Q2)

entry.band_read: a gap-framed opening in an identical treeline on both candidate edges - same density, same height, same opacity, same silhouette (FIELD.THE_HARD_CONSTRAINT, restated below)
entry.stitch: the entry band maps 1:1 onto the crossed field edge midpoint; the field-side silhouette of the treeline must be byte-for-byte the same read whichever edge was crossed

depth_reading.0_to_40_m: entry light - treeline behind you, camp clearing ahead (the shrine sits close enough that the portal reads as a door, not a teleport: CAMP.why_this_origin)
depth_reading.40_to_150_m: working forest - pines, herb scatter (FIELD.scatter_rule applies zone-wide), beast roam
depth_reading.150_to_220_m: deep forest - the spirit wound sits here; denser pines, the destination of the dive
depth_reading.why_zones_need_a_read_at_all: VISION_BOARD: the world announces what it wants by its shape alone. Depth bands give the generated blob a legible progression without authored paths.

budget.pine_clumps: clumps of 3-8 pines, mean spacing ~18 m, density ramping with depth (sparse at entry, dense at the wound band)
budget.herb_scatter: FIELD.scatter_rule verbatim - common nodes ~30 m apart, 25% duals, 5% triples, no grid (Lead 2026-10-07, x6 pass)
budget.camp_clearing: the camp's own 108 m clearing envelope (CAMP.size_m) is a SLOT, not scatter - it is punched out of the pine budget around the camp origin so the modules never intersect trunks
budget.beasts: not authored here - roam budget belongs to the beast spec; the generator only reserves open ground (clearing + wound band) from trunk collision
budget.numbers_status: agent-proposed, flagged for the Lead - counts are budgets the generator must stay UNDER, not targets it must hit

slots.note: entry-relative. The spirit node you come down through. Sits ~15 m before the camp so arrival reads as walking up to the camp through a door (CAMP.why_this_origin).

slots.piece: CAMP assembly - 5 SM_Camp_* modules + NODE_GUARD, 2x NODE_SLEEPER, NODE_CAPTIVE + 3 triggers + 2 light sources
slots.at_note: camp origin relative to entry band; delta from SLOT_SHRINE_RETURN is (14, 5) = ~14.9 m, preserving the shrine-to-CAMP spacing CAMP.json was authored with
slots.template: Lib/02_Zones/combat/CAMP.json - all internal at_offsets (bedrolls -2.5/2.0 and -2.5/3.2, captive 0/4, guard post 3/-2, portal 0/0) stay relative to THIS slot origin
slots.placement_rule: inserted after the pine scatter so the clearing envelope is respected; never generated into FIELD - the field template has zero camp slots (structural, asserted by test)
slots.visibility_note: camp sits ~240 m from FIELD's centre behind at least one treeline band, which is what FIELD's reject camp_visible_from_the_field_centre demands

slots.note: deep band, off the entry axis so reaching it means committing into the forest rather than walking a line. Wounded wisps scatter around it per the wound spec.

slots.piece: reserved - rune, tending soil, further authored set pieces
slots.note: PoE unique-room pattern: authored pieces live in slots, not in the scatter. New musts that belong to the forest get a slot here instead of a world coordinate.

identity_rules: THE_HARD_CONSTRAINT (restated from FIELD): both forest instances - whichever edge - must present IDENTICAL silhouettes from inside the field: same density, same height, same opacity, same entry read. Enforced structurally: both edges point at THIS template with the same shape parameters; only the seed (and therefore the interior) differs, and only after the player has entered.
The camp/wound/shrine slots are the zone's anchors - guaranteed present every instance, like PoE's boss room. This is the 'feel less generative' mechanism: layout varies, landmarks do not.
No man-made anything in FIELD (its own reject list); no forest identity markers in the entry band beyond the treeline gap - the forest announces itself with trees, not signage.
rejects: camp_in_the_field (STRUCTURAL: FIELD's template has no camp slot - asserted by automation, not by review)

state_and_saves.deltas: which camp actors are calm, whether the companion is freed, which wisps are healed/freed/tamed, tended soil, gathered nodes
state_and_saves.rule: reload regenerates from seed then applies deltas - a zone is never serialized whole

build_order: 1. DONE 2026-10-07: FHomeWorldZoneGenerator (shape jitter, shared pine-edge drift, herb scatter, pine cap). Tests HomeWorld.T0.ZoneGenerator.

2. DONE 2026-10-07: FHomeWorldZoneCrossing. The first pine_forest edge instantiates this zone from SeedForEdge; crossing it again reactivates that instance; the other pine edge stays dormant. Cliff and river open no T0 neighbor.

3. DONE 2026-10-07: slots with an authored offset are pinned after scatter and do not jitter. CAMP.json parts that already have at_offset are placed from the camp origin. The 108 m clearing is subtracted from the pine budget. Parts with no offset (fire, lashings, guard stake) stay unplaced. Prove scripts M8/M10-M14 against generated geometry are still open.
4. Only then: density dressing (grass/trees via PCG or HISM) under the locked art-bible reads.

rejects_note: camp_in_the_field is the first reject in this project's history that is enforced by a unit test rather than a review checklist. That is the point of the generation architecture: some rules should be structurally impossible instead of merely discouraged.
